description: Source mutations for ToolOrdering::assign_custom_gcodes custom-G-code mode/event assignment.

mutants.description: The mode mismatch gate must suppress ColorChange and ToolChange events when the model mode and actual print mode disagree; the two-object mismatch row has an active filament-2 color event that exposes this gate.

Pause and Custom events are mode-independent and must remain assigned to their layer; replacing the non-color/non-tool classification with the color/tool classification drops those events in every positive row.
